### What this changes

A short description of the change and the motivation.

### Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated (including any security regression the change guards:
      forgery, scope widening, replay, prefix-stripping).
- [ ] `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` pass locally for affected crates.
- [ ] Docs updated (affected package README, `agentcreds.pyi` if the Python surface changed).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under `[Unreleased]` for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Wire-format / public-API changes are called out explicitly (pre-1.0).
- [ ] All commits are signed off under the [DCO](../DCO) (`git commit -s`).
